policy: Official sources only: FEC bulk downloads (2026) and Hawaii Campaign Spending Commission Socrata dataset jexd-xbcg. No OpenFEC DEMO_KEY, no Ballotpedia, no OpenSecrets, no aggregators. Names and amounts copied as filed; nothing invented. No scores, no labels, no commentary. Donor lists are never sold.

pac_contributions.24Z: In-kind contribution made to registered filer
pac_contributions.note: pas2 rows only; MEMO_CD=X excluded and counted; negative amounts (refunds/voids) are kept and reduce totals.

outside_spending.24E: Independent expenditure advocating election of candidate -> support
outside_spending.24A: Independent expenditure opposing election of candidate -> oppose
outside_spending.24F: Communication cost for candidate (only for Form 7 filer) -> support
outside_spending.24N: Communication cost against candidate (only for Form 7 filer) -> oppose
outside_spending.note: 24E/24A from pas2 plus unique rows from independent_expenditure_2026.csv. 24F/24N are FEC Form 7 communication costs by corporations/unions (committee type C); they are NOT party-coordinated, so they are placed here with transaction_type kept on every row so the site can separate them.

party_coordinated.note: pas2 24C only (all filers are party committees, type Y). 24F/24N moved to outside_spending (see note).

txn_types_included.excluded: pas2 also defines 24H, 24P, 24R; none present in this pas226 extract.

dedupe_method.pas2: No dedupe inside pas2: each row is a distinct record (SUB_ID). Repeated (CMTE_ID, TRAN_ID) pairs in pas2 were inspected and are separate transactions (e.g. original + void reusing the original TRAN_ID).
ie_file_internal: 1) drop every row of a filing whose FILE_NUM is cited as PREV_FILE_NUM by a later filing from the same spender (amended reports replace the earlier report)

2) among remaining rows, exact repeats across different filings (same spender + TRAN_ID + candidate + amount + expenditure date + dissemination date + support/oppose): keep only the copy in the highest FILE_NUM. TRAN_ID alone is not used as a key because some filers number transactions per report and IDs collide across reports
ie_file_vs_pas2: pas2 amounts are whole dollars (cents dropped in the bulk file), so IE-file amounts are truncated to whole dollars for comparison only; IE-file rows that survive keep their exact cents
pas2 24E/24A rows (memo rows included for matching) are the reference; each pas2 row can absorb at most one IE-file row

tier 1: same filer + TRAN_ID + whole-dollar amount + (same date OR same candidate). TRAN_ID alone is NOT used because some filers number transactions per report (e.g. '1', 'F57.000001'), which collide across reports
tier 2: same filer + IMAGE_NUM + whole-dollar amount
tier 3: same filer + candidate + whole-dollar amount + date + support/oppose

remaining IE-file rows are added. Rows sharing filer + TRAN_ID + candidate with a pas2 row but a different amount are kept and flagged possible_pas2_duplicate=true (could be an amended amount or a different transaction)

committee_designation.P: Principal campaign committee of a candidate

transaction_type.24A: Independent expenditure opposing election of candidate
transaction_type.24E: Independent expenditure advocating election of candidate
transaction_type.24F: Communication cost for candidate (only for Form 7 filer)
transaction_type.24N: Communication cost against candidate (only for Form 7 filer)
transaction_type.24Z: In-kind contribution made to registered filer
